source.description: The MagicQ show this project was imported from (exports are written into a copy of it)

types.description: The fixture types (personalities) of the rig

curves.description: The dimmer curves heads can use

items.description: The rig: lamps and objects (trusses, pipes, boxes, people, models)

table.description: Output (0..65535) for each input 0..254; input 255 = full

number.description: Head number (cues and palettes refer to heads by it)

type.description: Fixture type (a personality of the rig, by name)

address.description: DMX address of the first channel (absolute, 1-based: 513 = universe 2, channel 1)

channels.description: Number of DMX channels from the address

gel.description: Gel (colour table id: 1000 + n = Lee n, 2000 + n = Rosco n); missing = open white

beam.description: Beam angle set in the patch (whole degrees); missing = the fixture type's (°)

shape.description: Beam shape id set in the patch (MagicVis); missing = none

curve.description: Dimmer curve (a curve of the rig, by id); missing = linear

id.description: The item's id, unique in the show (lamp files and blocking refer to it; the MagicVis id when imported)

kind.description: What it is: fixture, proscenium, pipe, box, person, podium, model, border (or a MagicVis object type number)

parent.description: Id of the truss / pipe / stand it hangs on; missing = none

rot.description: Rotation about x, y, z (Euler order Y-X-Z; lamps point down at 0) (°)

size.description: Sizes of an object (a pipe: length; a box: depth, width, height) (m)

name.description: Name of an object (e.g. the truss name LX1)

model.description: File name of a custom model (MagicVis .mvm)

address.description: DMX address of a lamp (absolute, 1-based: 513 = universe 2, channel 1); missing = not patched

head.description: Head number of a lamp (the head of the patch it belongs to)

type.description: Fixture type of a lamp (a personality of the rig, by name)

name.description: Name of the fixture type (MagicQ's personality name, e.g. generic_dimmer, Robe_RobinT1Profile_Mode1)

channels.description: The DMX channels' names, in DMX order

classes.description: What each channel is, one letter per channel in DMX order: I intensity, P position, C colour, B beam

gdtf.description: GDTF file of the fixture type (file name prefix in data/gdtf), for its attributes in physical values

gdtfMode.description: The GDTF mode matching the channels, e.g. "Mode 1 - CMY"
